title: CI Outage Witness
user: Maintainers of critical GitHub Actions pipelines who need an evidence bundle that distinguishes a repository failure, runner failure, and platform degradation when logs are delayed or absent.
smallest_useful_product: A GitHub CLI extension that snapshots run metadata, job transitions, available logs, runner diagnostics, GitHub status components, and retry lineage into one redacted incident bundle.
constraints: Use read-only GitHub scopes; strip tokens, repository secrets, and configured log patterns; label status observations with timestamp and uncertainty.
